sources.title: ATH-MaaS/Ovis2.5-9B - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: It integrates a native-resolution vision transformer (NaViT) that processes images at their original, variable resolutions, eliminating the need for fixed-resolution tiling and preserving both fine details and global layout—crucial for visually dense content such as charts and diagrams. To strengthen reasoning, Ovis2.5 is trained not only on linear chain-of-thought (CoT) but also on reflective reasoning, including self-checking and revision.
